Ben-ammi_1: son of Lot and forebear of the Ammonites (Genesis 19:38)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Abiathar_1: son of Ahimelech, the priest (1 Samuel 22:20), counselor to David (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Absalom_1: third-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:3)
Zadok_1: son of Ahitub and priest during King David's reign (2 Samuel 8:17), a mighty of valor (1 Chronicles 12:28)
Machir_2: the person who sheltered Jonathan's son Mephibosheth (2 Samuel 9:4)
Ahithophel_1: David's counselor, the Gilonite (2 Samuel 15:12, 1 Chronicles 27:32)
Ahimaaz_2: son of Zadok the priest (2 Samuel 15:27)
Jonathan_3: son of Abiathar the priest (2 Samuel 15:27)
Hushai_1: the Archite (2 Samuel 15:32), David's friend (1 Chronicles 27:33)
Amasa_1: set over David's army in place of Joab (2 Samuel 17:25)
Abigail_2: daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 17:25), (half-?) sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Nahash_2: mother of Abigail (2 Samuel 17:25) [and wife of Jesse, David's father (1 Chr 2:13-16) ?]
Shobi_1: the son of Nahash from Rabbah (2 Samuel 17:27)
